text: 「媽、麻、馬、罵」四個字，哪一個是國語的第三聲？
gloss: Which of 媽 麻 馬 罵 is Mandarin tone 3? — 馬 (mǎ): the four are the four tones in order, so the third is 馬.

text: 注音符號的順序是ㄅ、ㄆ、ㄇ，接下來是哪一個？
gloss: Bopomofo runs ㄅ ㄆ ㄇ ... what comes next? — ㄈ: the order is ㄅㄆㄇㄈ, ㄉㄊㄋㄌ.

text: 春節時把「福」字倒著貼，是取「倒」和哪個字同音？
gloss: At New Year the 福 character is hung upside down because 倒 (dào) sounds like which word? — 到: "福倒了" sounds like "福到了", fortune has arrived.

text: 下列哪個成語，是形容做事專心、沒有別的念頭？
gloss: Which idiom describes being single-minded? — 一心一意: "one heart, one mind"; 三心二意 is the opposite.

text: 中秋節夜晚，台灣家家戶戶最盛行的戶外活動是什麼？
gloss: On Mid-Autumn night, what outdoor activity is most popular in Taiwanese homes? — Barbecue, a beloved Taiwanese Mid-Autumn custom (dragon boats are for the Dragon Boat Festival).

text: 台灣夜市的名小吃「蚵仔煎」，裡面的「蚵仔」指的是什麼？
gloss: In the night-market dish 蚵仔煎, what is 蚵仔? — Oysters.

text: 香港茶餐廳裡的「鴛鴦」，是把哪兩種飲料混在一起？
gloss: In a Hong Kong cha chaan teng, 鴛鴦 mixes which two drinks? — Coffee and milk tea (yuenyeung).

text: 香港人搭地鐵、巴士常用的儲值交通卡，叫做什麼？
gloss: Hong Kong's common stored-value transit card? — Octopus (八達通); 悠遊卡 and 一卡通 are Taiwan's, 嶺南通 is Guangdong's.

text: 以湖光山色聞名的日月潭，位在台灣哪個縣市？
gloss: Sun Moon Lake is in which Taiwanese county? — Nantou County.

text: 簡譜的 1 2 3 4 唱成 Do、Re、Mi、Fa，接下來的 5 要唱成什麼？
gloss: In numbered notation 1 2 3 4 are Do Re Mi Fa; how is 5 sung? — Sol: the scale goes on Do Re Mi Fa Sol La Si.

text: 在 LINE 裡，對方看過你的訊息後，訊息旁會顯示哪兩個字？
gloss: In LINE, what word appears beside a message once the other person has seen it? — 已讀 ("read").

text: 明朝鄭和七次率領大船隊出海遠航，歷史上稱為「鄭和下○○」，空格裡是什麼？
gloss: Zheng He's seven voyages are known as "Zheng He goes down to the ... Ocean". — 西洋 (the Western Seas).

text: 《西遊記》裡，唐僧師徒一路向西，是要到哪裡取經？
gloss: In Journey to the West, where do the pilgrims travel to fetch scriptures? — Tianzhu, i.e. India.

text: 牛郎與織女的傳說中，兩人一年一度相會的日子是哪一天？
gloss: The Cowherd and Weaver Girl meet once a year on which day? — The seventh day of the seventh lunar month (Qixi).

text: 「文房四寶」是筆、墨、紙，再加上哪一樣？
gloss: The "four treasures of the study" are brush, ink, paper and...? — The inkstone (硯).

text: 「原價 500 元的外套打八折」，要付多少錢？
gloss: A 500-dollar coat is "8 zhe" off; what do you pay? — 400: 打八折 means paying 80% of the price, not taking 80% off.

text: 電影演職員表播完後，才出現的額外小片段，俗稱什麼？
gloss: What is the extra short scene shown after the end credits of a film called? — A post-credits scene, nicknamed 彩蛋 ("Easter egg"); 花絮 is behind-the-scenes footage.

text: 瀏覽網頁時，畫面出現「404」，通常代表什麼意思？
gloss: What does a "404" page usually mean? — The requested page was not found.

text: 手機開啟「飛航模式」後，最主要會停用哪一類功能？
gloss: What does airplane mode mainly switch off? — Wireless radio signals (calls and mobile data).

text: 下列哪一種容器，絕對不能放進微波爐加熱？
gloss: Which container must never go in a microwave? — The aluminium-foil tray: metal reflects microwaves and can spark.

text: 裝滿水的玻璃瓶放進冷凍庫可能會裂開，是因為水結成冰時體積會怎樣？
gloss: A full glass bottle can crack in the freezer because water, when it freezes, ... — expands.

text: 下列哪一種食物，對狗來說可能中毒，不能隨便餵？
gloss: Which food can poison a dog and should not be fed to it? — Chocolate (theobromine); the other three are safe.

text: 電梯面板上，兩個箭頭相對的「▶◀」按鈕，通常是用來做什麼？
gloss: In a lift, what does the ▶◀ button (arrows pointing at each other) do? — Closes the door: the arrows squeeze together.

text: 義式咖啡裡的「拿鐵」，是在濃縮咖啡中加入大量的什麼？
gloss: A latte is espresso with a lot of what? — Milk.

text: 想親眼看見極光，下列哪個地方最合適？
gloss: Where would you go to see the aurora? — Iceland: auroras appear at high latitudes, the other three are tropical.

text: 足球比賽中，裁判有時會看螢幕重播再判決，這套「VAR」是用來做什麼？
options: 用影像回放協助裁判判決
gloss: In football, what is VAR, the system referees use to look at replays? — Video assistant referee: it uses video replay to help the referee decide.

text: 寶可夢裡最有名的角色皮卡丘，屬於哪一種屬性？
gloss: Pikachu, the best-known Pokémon, is which type? — Electric.

text: 流行歌曲裡，最容易讓人朗朗上口、會重複出現的段落，叫做什麼？
gloss: In a pop song, what is the catchy section that repeats? — The chorus (副歌).

text: 成語「半斤八兩」比喻彼此差不多，是因為舊制一斤等於幾兩？
gloss: The idiom 半斤八兩 ("half a jin, eight liang") means "much the same" because an old jin was how many liang? — 16, so half a jin is 8 liang.

text: 日曆上寫著「廿五日」，指的是幾號？
gloss: A calendar shows "廿五日"; which date is it? — The 25th: 廿 is the single character for twenty.

text: 香港著名的「山頂纜車」，是通往哪一座山的山頂？
gloss: Hong Kong's Peak Tram climbs to the top of which mountain? — Victoria Peak (太平山).

text: 台灣黑熊的胸前，有一塊什麼形狀的白色斑紋？
gloss: Taiwanese black bears have a white patch on the chest shaped like...? — A V.

text: 太空人在艙外，面對面卻聽不見彼此直接說話，是因為太空中有什麼特別之處？
gloss: Why can't spacewalking astronauts hear each other directly? — Sound needs a medium and space has no air.

text: 網址開頭的「https」，最後那個「s」代表什麼意思？
gloss: In "https", what does the final s stand for? — Secure (encrypted connection).

text: 2008 年大賣的台灣電影《海角七號》，故事主要發生在南台灣哪個小鎮？
gloss: The 2008 Taiwanese hit Cape No. 7 is set mainly in which southern town? — Hengchun.

text: 搭飛機時，行動電源依規定應該放在哪裡？
gloss: On a flight, where must a power bank go? — In the carry-on bag: lithium batteries are banned from checked luggage because of fire risk.

text: 《紅樓夢》裡，一出生口中就含著一塊玉的人物是誰？
gloss: In Dream of the Red Chamber, who is born with a piece of jade in his mouth? — Jia Baoyu.

text: 吃壽司時附上的醃薑片，主要的用途是什麼？
options: 換吃下一種魚片前清口
gloss: What is the pickled ginger served with sushi mainly for? — To cleanse the palate between different fish.

text: 奧運會馬拉松的全程距離，大約是幾公里？
gloss: The Olympic marathon covers roughly how many kilometres? — 42 (42.195).

text: 麻辣鍋裡讓舌頭發麻的「麻」，主要來自哪一種香料？
gloss: Which spice gives hot-pot its numbing tingle? — Sichuan pepper (花椒).

text: 澳門的地標「大三巴牌坊」，是哪一座教堂僅存的前壁？
gloss: Macau's Ruins of St. Paul's are the surviving façade of which church? — The Church of St. Paul (聖保祿教堂).

text: 遊戲《Minecraft（麥塊）》裡，會悄悄靠近玩家再自爆的綠色怪物叫什麼？
gloss: In Minecraft, which green mob sneaks up and explodes? — The Creeper (苦力怕).

text: 爸爸的姊姊所生的兒子，年紀比你大，你要叫他什麼？
gloss: Your father's sister's older son is your...? — 表哥: 堂 is for the father's brother's children (same surname), 表 for the others.

text: 用大同電鍋煮飯，飯熟後開關會自動跳起來，是什麼原因？
options: 電鍋的計時器時間到了
鍋蓋的蒸氣把開關頂起
外鍋的水燒乾，溫度升到 100 度以上
gloss: Why does a Tatung rice cooker switch pop up by itself when the rice is done? — The outer-pot water has boiled away, so the temperature rises past 100 °C and trips the thermal switch; there is no timer.

text: 清朝末年，在台灣興建第一條鐵路的巡撫是誰？
gloss: Which Qing governor built Taiwan's first railway? — Liu Mingchuan (Keelung to Hsinchu).

text: 貝多芬《第九號交響曲》最後樂章的〈歡樂頌〉，歌詞取自哪位詩人？
gloss: Whose poem is the text of the "Ode to Joy" in Beethoven's Ninth? — Friedrich Schiller.

text: 手機常掃的 QR Code，最早是哪個國家的公司發明的？
gloss: The QR code was first invented by a company from which country? — Japan (Denso Wave, 1994).

text: 下列金屬元素中，哪一個是最輕、密度最小的金屬？
gloss: Which metal is the lightest? — Lithium.

text: 名畫《清明上河圖》的作者是哪一位畫家？
gloss: Who painted Along the River During the Qingming Festival? — Zhang Zeduan (Song dynasty).

text: 哪一個國家的領土，同時橫跨東、西、南、北四個半球？
gloss: Which country lies in all four hemispheres? — Kiribati (equator and the 180th meridian both cross it).
